## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(sf)

library(here)
library(gghdx)
gghdx()
```

Pixel Values 
```{r}
tar_load(df_fs_pixel_values)
df_fs_pixel_values %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>% 
  filter(value>0.005) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x= value))+
  geom_histogram()+
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels= scales::label_percent()
  )+
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of all non-zero flood fraction pixel values (FloodScan)"
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )

```


Percentile table

```{r}
df_adm1_historical_pct %>% 
  filter(
    adm1_en =="Banadir" 
  ) %>% 
  print(n=nrow(.))

    
df_adm1_historical_pct2 %>%
  mutate(
    seas_label = if_else(month(date)==3,"MAM","OND")
  ) %>% 
      ggplot(
        aes(x= pct_pop_exposed_24,y = reorder(adm1_en,pct_pop_exposed_24))
      )+
      geom_boxplot()+
      scale_x_continuous(
        labels= scales::comma
      )+
  scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::percent)+
  facet_wrap(~seas_label)+
  labs(
    title= "Distribution of population exposed over MAM and OND historically",
    subtitle = "Somalia - FloodScan (1998-2022) + WorldPop 2020 UN adjusted"
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )
    
df_adm1_historical_pct2 %>%
  mutate(
    seas_label = if_else(month(date)==3,"MAM","OND")
  ) %>% 
      ggplot(
        aes(x= pop_exposed_24,y = reorder(adm1_en,pop_exposed_24))
      )+
      geom_boxplot()+
  scale_x_continuous(labels= scales::label_number_si(),
                     breaks= seq(0, 4e6, 50000)
                     )+
  # scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::percent)+
  facet_wrap(~seas_label)+
  labs(
    title= "Distribution of population exposed over MAM and OND historically",
    subtitle = "Somalia - FloodScan (1998-2022) + WorldPop 2020 UN adjusted"
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)
  )

```

```{r}
tar_load(df_adm1_exposure_quantiles)

df_adm1_pctile_long <- df_adm1_exposure_quantiles %>%
      filter(mo==10 & q %in% c(0.25,0.75)|
               mo== 3 & q %in% c(0.5,0.95))

  
df_crossbar <- df_adm1_pctile_long %>% 
      select(matches("adm"),mo,q,matches("_exposed_")) %>% 
      group_by(
        across(matches("adm")),mo
      ) %>% 
      mutate(
        cat = if_else(q==min(q),"low","high"),
         seas_label = if_else(mo==3,"MAM","OND")
      ) %>% 
      select(-q,-mo) %>% 
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = cat,
        values_from=c("pct_pop_exposed_24","pop_exposed_24")
        ) %>% 
  ungroup()

df_adm1_historical_pct %>% 
  
   mutate(
    seas_label = if_else(month(date)==3,"MAM","OND")
  ) %>% 
  left_join(df_crossbar) %>% 
  mutate(
    pct_pop_exposed_24_cat = if_else(
      pct_pop_exposed_24>=pct_pop_exposed_24_low & pct_pop_exposed_24<=pct_pop_exposed_24_high,"in range","out"
    )
  ) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x=pct_pop_exposed_24, 
             y= reorder(adm1_en,pct_pop_exposed_24),
             
             # fill=alpha(pct_pop_exposed_24_cat,0.2)
             ))+
  geom_jitter(
    width=0,height =0.4,
     alpha=0.5,
    aes(
      color=pct_pop_exposed_24_cat,
    )
  )+
   geom_segment(data = df_crossbar,
              aes(y=adm1_en,
                  yend= adm1_en,
                  x= pct_pop_exposed_24_low,
                  xend= pct_pop_exposed_24_high),color="darkgreen"
              )+
  facet_wrap(~seas_label)+
  scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::percent,trans=scales::pseudo_log_trans())+
  labs(
    title = "Somalia Historical % Population Exposed to Flooding",
    subtitle = "Percentile ranges used to set boundaries shown in green (50-95th for MAM & 25-57th for OND)",
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none"
  )


 
```
